_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "department" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "session" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "semester" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "total_expected" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.0, "count_rule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all', "count_n" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_part" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "max" REAL NOT NULL, "min" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "pass_mark" REAL NULL, "step" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "marked_out_of" REAL NULL, "counts_for" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'typed', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_question" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "q_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max" REAL NOT NULL, "compulsory" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("compulsory" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grade_scale" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "min_score" REAL NOT NULL, "max_score" REAL NOT NULL, "letter" TEXT NOT NULL, "points" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheme_template" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "reg_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "on_class_list" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("on_class_list" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "upload_batch" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scan" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "page_no" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scanned', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES upload_batch (id), "original_name" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "booklet" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "student_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES student (id), "scan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES scan (id), "serial_no" TEXT NULL, "read_json" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scanned', "confirmed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "question_mark" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "booklet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES booklet (id), "q_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark" REAL NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "row_read" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "scan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scan (id), "row_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "raw_id" TEXT NULL, "raw_value" TEXT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES student (id), "part_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES course_part (id), "value" REAL NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "part_score" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id), "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student (id), "part_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course_part (id), "value" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'entered', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'typed', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "correction" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "crop_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "read_value" TEXT NULL, "confirmed_value" TEXT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recognition_run" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "scan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scan (id), "pipeline_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete', "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "result_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_review" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "scan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scan (id), "run_id" TEXT NULL, "field_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "machine_value" TEXT NULL, "machine_state" TEXT NULL, "final_value" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "plan" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free', "plan_valid_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pull_at" TEXT NULL, "last_push_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX course_code ON course (code)
CREATE INDEX course_part_course ON course_part (course_id)
CREATE INDEX exam_question_course ON exam_question (course_id)
CREATE INDEX grade_scale_course ON grade_scale (course_id)
CREATE INDEX student_course ON student (course_id)
CREATE INDEX student_reg_no ON student (course_id, reg_no)
CREATE INDEX upload_batch_course ON upload_batch (course_id)
CREATE INDEX scan_course ON scan (course_id)
CREATE INDEX scan_batch ON scan (batch_id)
CREATE INDEX scan_hash ON scan (course_id, content_hash)
CREATE INDEX booklet_course ON booklet (course_id)
CREATE INDEX question_mark_booklet ON question_mark (booklet_id)
CREATE INDEX row_read_scan ON row_read (scan_id)
CREATE INDEX part_score_course ON part_score (course_id)
CREATE INDEX part_score_cell ON part_score (student_id, part_id)
CREATE INDEX recognition_run_scan ON recognition_run (scan_id)
CREATE INDEX field_review_scan ON field_review (scan_id)
